description: [Compliance & counterparty] Screen a new counterparty (person or company) in one call before onboarding, contracting or paying it. Use for a first-pass screen before human review. Price: $0.10 per call (USDC on Base, x402). Returns the x402 payment requirements unless payment_signature is given. Sample: /samples/due-diligence

dob.description: Optional date of birth YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD (persons)

lei.description: Optional LEI to verify the company exactly

payment_signature.description: Optional x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value, relayed unchanged to the endpoint. Omit to receive the payment requirements.
